literal: Burden together upon when coming having borne, to the king tax fully that which pays is a country.
translation: A true country is one that can bear a heavy burden when it falls upon it all at once, and still pay its taxes in full to the king.
modern: தன் மேல் ஒருசேர வரும் சுமையைத் தாங்கிக்கொண்டு, அரசனுக்குச் செலுத்த வேண்டிய வரியை முழுமையாகச் செலுத்துவதே சிறந்த நாடாகும்.
explanation: This couplet describes the resilience and wealth of an ideal country. The word 'பொறை' (burden) refers to unexpected pressures, such as an influx of migrants or natural hardships, that fall upon the land all at once ('ஒருங்கு'). A strong nation bears this weight ('தாங்கி') without its economy collapsing. Even while managing such heavy burdens, it remains prosperous enough to pay its taxes ('இறை') in full ('ஒருங்கு') to the ruler ('இறைவற்கு').
